    s.sname, 
    s.cname, 
    s.avgscrwrite
FROM 
    satscores s
JOIN 
    schools frpm ON s.cds = frpm.cdscode
WHERE 
    s.avgscrwrite > 499 AND frpm.charter IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    s.avgscrwrite DESC	----- bird -----	california_schools
140:
SELECT AVG(s.numtsttakr) AS avg_test_takers
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.cdscode
JOIN schools sch ON f.cdscode = sch.cdscode
WHERE sch.opendate >= '1980-01-01' AND sch.opendate <= '1980-12-31' AND f."County Name" = 'Fresno'	----- bird -----	california_schools
141:
SELECT s.sname 
FROM satscores s 
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.cdscode 
WHERE s.avgscrread IN ( 
  SELECT s2.avgscrread 
  FROM satscores s2 
  JOIN schools sc2 ON s2.cds = sc2.cdscode 
  GROUP BY sc2.county 
  ORDER BY AVG(s2.avgscrread) DESC 
  LIMIT 5 
) AND sc.statustype = 'F' AND sc.virtual = 'F' 
ORDER BY s.avgscrread DESC	----- bird -----	california_schools
142:
SELECT s.sname, s.enroll12 
FROM satscores s 
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.cdscode 
WHERE sc.doc = 31 AND s.enroll12 > 0 
ORDER BY s.enroll12 DESC	----- bird -----	california_schools
143:
SELECT sc.street AS "Postal Street Address", sc.school AS "School Name"
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.cdscode
ORDER BY s.avgscrmath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6	----- bird -----	california_schools
